root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately before `TMS320C64x_insn_name()` indexes `insn_name_maps`, the lookup id must be strictly smaller than the actual `insn_name_maps` array length, not merely below the enum sentinel `TMS320C64X_INS_ENDING`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable function reaches the lookup with `id == 21` while the vulnerable `insn_name_maps` declaration has only 3 contiguous elements, so the missing array-bounds conjunct is false on the crashing path. The fixed program executes the same lookup with the same `id == 21`, but the completed table raises `ARR_SIZE(insn_name_maps)` to 145 and makes the missing predicate true.

nodes.description: At the source-level sanitizer sink, `TMS320C64x_insn_name()` uses the carried `id` directly as the global `insn_name_maps` subscript in `return insn_name_maps[id].name;`.

edges.relation: After the sentinel-only guard admits the call, the same `id` is used unchanged as the subscript in the subsequent `insn_name_maps[id]` lookup.
The public TMS320C64x instruction enum written to `insn->id` at `TMS320C64x_get_insn_id()` later arrives unchanged as the `id` argument checked by `TMS320C64x_insn_name()`.
